queries.description: Find all elevation datasets with resolution <= 10m and quality_score >= 0.92 that spatially intersect the target region. Compute the fraction of the target region covered by the union of matching datasets' bounding boxes (each clipped to the target).

output_format.matching_dataset_ids: sorted array of dataset_id strings for datasets passing ALL filters AND spatially intersecting target_bbox
output_format.union_coverage_fraction: float: area of union of (each matching geometry clipped to target_bbox) divided by area of target_bbox. Areas in degree-squared.

queries.description: Find all datasets whose temporal range overlaps the year 2021 (temporal_start <= '2021-12-31' AND temporal_end >= '2021-01-01') and whose bounding box geometry has strictly positive intersection area with the target region.
For each unique category value in the catalog, compute the sum of individual dataset bounding box areas. Bounding box area = (east - west) * (north - south) in degree-squared units.

output_format.category_areas: object mapping each category string to its total area as a float (degree-squared)
